chunks: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'A sitting that I sit in with one I trust is more strengthening for my soul than working for a year.'

key_terms.أثق: I trust, I have confidence in — implying deep reliance on integrity and piety
key_terms.أوثق: More firmly strengthening, more consolidating — comparative form expressing superiority in spiritual effect
key_terms.مجلس: Gathering, sitting, scholarly session — a structured meeting for learning or spiritual companionship
key_terms.نفس: Soul, self — here referring to the inner spiritual state

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about the value of sitting with a trustworthy companion?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) extols the spiritual benefit of companionship with trustworthy people — specifically, a single session spent with a reliable companion surpasses an entire year of individual spiritual effort. This saying, transmitted through the distinguished Sunni-background narrator Sufyan ibn Uyayna, would have resonated with the scholarly circles of Medina and Kufa who valued the transformative power of sitting with learned and righteous figures. The Imam is affirming that sincere fellowship in knowledge and piety is itself a form of worship of the highest order.
